cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?

mechanism: A uses its former pupil scheduling habits to reconstruct an unnamed visitor journey while avoiding the direct identity question B offers.
confusable: Not seeking a general timetable for its own sake: B exposes the hidden visitor inquiry and A keeps asking adjacent time and route facts.
comparison: Guest drink preferences versus late meal and last bus route.
seedUse: D222 light/extra plate/ask who/late/bus; S05 taught timetable planning.
